title: Kid Howard's resignation before the England trip
summary: Looking at a George Lewis souvenir program, Williams says Howard had stopped playing and that he told him he was too good a musician to resign.

bands.name: George Lewis New Orleans Jazz Band

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: Well, I put a pretty good band. Then I noticed in here you've got a write-up. Kid Howard, this is in a program, George Lewis New Orleans jazz band, a souvenir thing, from when he was in England.

Yeah. But you see at that time when Howard made that trip, Howard had absolutely resigned. Had stopped playing. And I told him he was a too damn good musician to resign. Don't worry about them guys. Because when he was in prime he gave them plenty of wood. He lost a lot of business to sheep. See sheep? They didn't want sheep. Because sheep could never come up to understand him. And he lost a lot of business. He said, what the hell? They don't tell me who I want. See? See? I can't figure out what year this was, but it was in January.
